tile_name: 1). seamless tileable ground texture seen from dir
tile_description: 1). seamless tileable ground texture seen from directly above, wet dark steel deck plates with rivets at night, uniform, no objects, lineless, high top-down 2). seamless tileable ground texture seen from directly above, cracked wet concrete pier floor with small puddles at night, uniform, no objects, lineless, high top-down 3). seamless tileable ground texture seen from directly above, rusty metal grating over dark teal water at night, uniform, no objects, lineless, high top-down 4). seamless tileable ground texture seen from directly above, frozen dark teal harbor concrete with frost patches at night, uniform, no objects, lineless, high top-down

experiment_art_direction.art_direction: The primary surface material for the deck plates, concrete, and frozen concrete will utilize a cool, desaturated blue-grey palette to evoke the cold, metallic, and wet night-time industrial setting. Highlights will have a subtle warmth to suggest reflected artificial light, while shadows will deepen into the base hue. The metal grating will feature a distinct rusty accent on this base. The side faces, where visible for the grating, will be a deep, dark teal-green to represent the water beneath or the subsurface of the pier, contrasting with the surface material.
